notes: Compatible patch release carrying the accepted listener-free request-latency baseline for issue #323. The explicit test-only harness measures authenticated current-user, Slots state, Roulette state, aggregate Casino state, and idempotent Boule actions by direct production-WSGI invocation against isolated external JSON and callback-owned disposable loopback MySQL providers. Every route family uses fixed warm-up work followed by sixty-four measured operations at concurrency one, two, four, and eight through a rolling at-most-N scheduler and the repository's default MySQL pool settings. Authentication, first-write, replay, conflict, receipt-retention, and authoritative wallet checks remain untimed. Evidence is aggregate-only, exact-source, strictly allowlisted, and contains no identity, authentication, raw request, wager, outcome, sample, path, host, database, timestamp, or exception detail. The baseline defines no hardware-dependent latency threshold, opens no listener, and changes no runtime route, API contract, provider implementation, pool default, game, production workflow, or deployment behavior. No database schema, provider, DNS, billing, public signup, live OAuth, mail, invitation, public exposure, credential, or SSH-ingress behavior changes. Exact immutable v0.9.5.34 remains the application-only predecessor, MySQL schema 2 remains exact, and database rollback is prohibited.
